name: workbench
description: Agent team, task-aware dashboard pane, local Markdown second brain and natural-writing skill for Claude Code.

brainPath.title: Second brain folder
brainPath.description: Absolute path of the Markdown knowledge base. Empty means <home>/repos/second-brain.

injectMemories.title: Attach relevant notes to prompts
injectMemories.description: Search the second brain on each prompt and attach the few best matches as hidden context.

maxMemoriesPerPrompt.title: Notes attached per prompt
maxMemoriesPerPrompt.description: Upper bound on second-brain notes attached to one prompt.

teamPolicy.title: Team routing policy
teamPolicy.description: Add the agent-team routing and coordination rules to the system prompt.

autoOpenDashboard.title: Open dashboard at start
autoOpenDashboard.description: Open the dashboard pane when a session starts (it stays closed on narrow terminals).

maxParallelAgents.title: Parallel agent limit
maxParallelAgents.description: Agent calls are refused while this many subagents are already running.

maxReviewRounds.title: Review rounds per request
maxReviewRounds.description: How many critic or QA reviews one request may start.

taskBudgetUsd.title: Budget per request (USD)
taskBudgetUsd.description: Spend for one request before the plugin stops new subagents and research and asks Claude to wrap up. 0 turns it off.

sessionBudgetUsd.title: Budget per session (USD)
sessionBudgetUsd.description: Warnings from usageWarnPercent of this; no new subagents past it. 0 turns it off.

reservePercent.title: Reserve for the answer (%)
reservePercent.description: The last part of a request's budget kept for verification and the final answer.

usageWarnPercent.title: Warn at (%)
usageWarnPercent.description: Warn when the session budget or the account's five-hour or seven-day usage window reaches this.

maxSearchesPerRequest.title: Web lookups per request
maxSearchesPerRequest.description: WebSearch and WebFetch calls allowed in the main conversation per request.

compactAtPercent.title: Compact at context (%)
compactAtPercent.description: Compact the conversation after a turn once the context window is this full. 0 leaves it to Claude Code's own auto-compact.

downgradeUnderPressure.title: Downgrade opus agents under pressure
downgradeUnderPressure.description: Run opus subagents on sonnet while account usage is past the warning level.

ledger.title: Task ledger
ledger.description: Keep a resumable ledger per project in the second brain's _ledgers folder.

requireReview.title: Require review of larger code changes
requireReview.description: When a request edits reviewMinFiles or more code files and no critic or QA review ran, ask Claude to get one before finishing (once per request). Say 'no review' or 'quick' in a request to skip it.

reviewMinFiles.title: Files that trigger a review
reviewMinFiles.description: Code files edited in one request before a review is required.
